title: Editor E1, slice 6: Guestbook joins the contract, so all 41 registry blocks are adopted
detail: Adopts guestbook, the last registry block. check:blocks holds 41 of 41. The completeness test in scripts/check-blocks.test.ts asserted that the full registry is NOT fully adopted, which cannot stay true once it is; it now asserts the same thing against the registry plus one block that is not adopted (owner approved the edit, decision card 2026-10-20). PROG-E1 stays open on the binding layer (the 146 page Apps still carry an empty surface descriptor).

verify.note: Fails while any registry block is not adopted.
